headline: Bronze Age "Sun Chariot" & a second fragment found at Trundholm
summary: Conservators at the National Museum confirm a second fragment of the Trundholm Sun Chariot.
facts: Second fragment found in the 1902 spoil heaps
post_text:
Archaeologists re-examined spoil heaps from the 1902 Trundholm excavation and recovered a second bronze fragment <matching> the Sun Chariot's spiral ornament.
The piece confirms the chariot was cast in at least two moulds, and traces of gold leaf survive on one edge.
Museum conservators date the casting to roughly 1400 BC.

web_sources.title: The Sun Chariot — National Museum of Denmark
web_sources.snippet: The Sun Chariot was found in 1902 in the Trundholm bog.
